استمعتن (form VIII)
# اِسْتَمَعْتُنَّ (istamaʕtunna) /is.ta.maʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# اُسْتُمِعْتُنَّ (ustumiʕtunna) /us.tu.miʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
